en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, four‑story corner building with neoclassical and early‑modern architectural elements: multiple balconies with balustrades, arched windows on the ground and first floors, and decorative cornices. Small early‑20th‑century cars and pedestrians appear in front of the building. There are electric poles and a metal lighting structure in the street. Greek script is visible at the bottom left of the image, and a website watermark appears in the lower right.
